SELECT s.id, s.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, w.type AS warehouse_type, s.material_sku_id, s.qty, k.safety_stock, s.update_time FROM s JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id JOIN bas_material_sku k ON k.id = s.material_sku_id JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id
AND s.qty != 0
AND s.id IN #{id}
ORDER BY w.code, k.code, s.id

SELECT s.material_sku_id, MAX(k.code) AS sku_code, MAX(k.safety_stock) AS safety_stock, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty) FILTER (WHERE w.type = 'MATERIAL'), 0) AS material_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty) FILTER (WHERE w.type = 'FACTORY'), 0) AS factory_qty, SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty FROM s JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id JOIN bas_material_sku k ON k.id = s.material_sku_id JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id
GROUP BY s.material_sku_id HAVING SUM(s.qty) != 0 ORDER BY MAX(k.code), s.material_sku_id
